title: Denmark Signs the North Atlantic Treaty

historical.summary: Denmark was one of the twelve founding signatories of the North Atlantic Treaty, signed in Washington on 4 April 1949. Foreign Minister Gustav Rasmussen signed for Denmark. The decision marked a departure from Denmark's earlier policy of neutrality. Article 5 established collective defence: each ally undertakes to assist an attacked ally with the action it considers necessary, including the use of armed force.
historical.uncertainty: The event date records the signing, not the treaty's entry into force on 24 August 1949. Collective defence does not prescribe an identical military response from every member.

satire.publicSummary: Standalone mode has been retired. The replacement security arrangement has twelve signatories and no single help desk. Each participant still has to implement its own response.
satire.commitMessage: feat(defence): replace standalone mode with an alliance dependency
satire.diagnosticMessage: Shared defence registered; national response implementations remain required.

da-DK.title: Danmark underskriver Den Nordatlantiske Traktat
da-DK.historicalSummary: Danmark var blandt de tolv oprindelige underskrivere af Den Nordatlantiske Traktat, der blev underskrevet i Washington den 4. april 1949. Udenrigsminister Gustav Rasmussen underskrev for Danmark. Beslutningen markerede et brud med Danmarks tidligere neutralitetspolitik. Artikel 5 fastlagde det kollektive forsvar: Hver allieret forpligter sig til at hjælpe en angrebet allieret med de handlinger, den anser for nødvendige, herunder brug af væbnet magt.
da-DK.historicalUncertainty: Begivenhedens dato angiver underskrivelsen, ikke traktatens ikrafttræden den 24. august 1949. Det kollektive forsvar foreskriver ikke en ensartet militær reaktion fra alle medlemmer.
da-DK.publicSummary: Drift på egen hånd er udfaset. Den nye sikkerhedsordning har tolv underskrivere og ingen fælles helpdesk. Hver deltager skal stadig selv implementere sin reaktion.
